action_items: (LOW / OPTIONAL) Admin spinner first-paint latency was ~1198ms in our run vs ~419ms for the 2-row demo user. Likely due to admin's 6-row watchlist re-rendering all WatchlistRow components when analyzingTicker state flips. Consider memoizing WatchlistRow with React.memo + a stable analyzing prop so flipping analyzingTicker only re-renders the targeted row. Not a regression — fix is working — just optimization.
critical_code_review_comments: DisclaimerModal.jsx ensureAccepted (line 214-232): clean fix. The `accepted !== false` predicate makes the click optimistic when accepted is still null (GET /disclaimer in flight). Backend still enforces (428 disclaimer_required) and promptFromError() handles that path. Correct asymmetry: client never blocks on unknown state, backend is source of truth.

DashboardPage.jsx analyzeOne (line 366-494) correctly wraps the action in disclaimer.ensureAccepted() and the action sets analyzingTicker BEFORE awaiting any network. Good — that's why the spinner renders within ~400ms even though the analyze API itself takes 20-60s.

AnalysisReportPage.jsx runAnalysis (line 124-168) uses the same ensureAccepted pattern, so the autorun=1 path shares the fix. Verified: View button -> autorun on /analysis/{ticker} does not surface a modal.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: useDisclaimer().ensureAccepted in DisclaimerModal.jsx previously gated the action on `accepted === true`. On a fresh page load, GET /disclaimer is in flight and `accepted` is null. If the user clicked Analyze before that request resolved, the gate failed (null !== true), the modal opened, and the analyzingTicker setter never ran -> no spinner. If the user dismissed the modal, the action was lost. FIX: change the predicate to `accepted !== false` so null and true both run the action immediately. The server still returns 428 disclaimer_required if the user genuinely hasn't accepted, and the existing promptFromError(err) catch path opens the modal in that case. Net result: zero-latency spinner for accepted users, correct gating for unaccepted users.
